drivers.text: Data Center revenue was 21,039 USDmm in 2026-Q3-YTD versus 11,255 USDmm in 2025-Q3-YTD; the forecast starts below that reported growth and moderates over the horizon.
Annual Data Center revenue increased from 6,496 USDmm in FY2023 to 12,579 USDmm in FY2024 and 16,635 USDmm in FY2025, supporting continued growth with deceleration.
Client and Gaming revenue was 11,168 USDmm in 2026-Q3-YTD versus 10,610 USDmm in 2025-Q3-YTD; the forecast assumes moderate growth that tapers toward the end of the horizon.

drivers.text: Annual Client and Gaming revenue was 10,863 USDmm in FY2023, 9,649 USDmm in FY2024, and 14,550 USDmm in FY2025, showing a variable history that supports a measured forecast.

drivers.text: Embedded revenue was 2,959 USDmm in 2026-Q3-YTD versus 2,504 USDmm in 2025-Q3-YTD; the forecast assumes modest growth after the reported increase.
Annual Embedded revenue declined from 5,321 USDmm in FY2023 to 3,557 USDmm in FY2024 and 3,454 USDmm in FY2025, supporting a cautious ramp from flat growth.
